Add carry and both variability values in.ko: 클럽을 비교하려면 내 골프백에서 캐리와 앞뒤·좌우 편차를 입력하세요.
Add carry and both variability values in.ja: クラブを比較するには、マイバッグでキャリーと前後・左右のばらつきを入力してください。
Add carry and both variability values in.zh-Hans: 在我的球包中输入空中距离及前后、左右离散值，即可比较球杆。
Add carry and both variability values in.zh-Hant: 在我的球袋中輸入空中距離及前後、左右離散值，即可比較球桿。
Add carry and both variability values in.es: Añade el vuelo y ambas variabilidades en Mi bolsa para comparar palos.
Add carry and both variability values in.pt-BR: Adicione o carry e as duas variabilidades em Minha bolsa para comparar tacos.
Add carry and both variability values in.de: Zum Vergleich Carry und beide Streuwerte in Meine Tasche eintragen.
Add carry and both variability values in.fr: Renseignez la portée et les deux dispersions dans Mon sac pour comparer les clubs.
Add carry and both variability values in.it: Inserisci carry e le due variabilità in La mia sacca per confrontare i bastoni.
Add carry and both variability values in.th: เพิ่มแคร์รี่และความแปรปรวนสองแนวในถุงกอล์ฟของฉันเพื่อเปรียบเทียบไม้
Add carry and both variability values in.vi: Nhập carry và độ biến thiên theo hai hướng trong Túi gậy để so sánh gậy.

Ball position: user-entered. Shot record.ko: 공 위치는 직접 입력했습니다. 샷 기록에는 항상 최신 GPS 위치를 사용합니다.
Ball position: user-entered. Shot record.ja: ボール位置は手動入力です。ショット記録には常に新しいGPS位置を使用します。
Ball position: user-entered. Shot record.zh-Hans: 球位由用户输入。记录击球时始终使用最新GPS定位。
Ball position: user-entered. Shot record.zh-Hant: 球位由使用者輸入。記錄擊球時一律使用最新GPS定位。
Ball position: user-entered. Shot record.es: Posición manual. Los golpes se registran siempre con una posición GPS reciente.
Ball position: user-entered. Shot record.pt-BR: Posição manual. As tacadas sempre usam uma localização GPS recente.
Ball position: user-entered. Shot record.de: Ballposition manuell. Schlagaufzeichnungen verwenden stets eine aktuelle GPS-Position.
Ball position: user-entered. Shot record.fr: Position saisie manuellement. Les coups utilisent toujours une position GPS récente.
Ball position: user-entered. Shot record.it: Posizione manuale. I colpi usano sempre una posizione GPS recente.
Ball position: user-entered. Shot record.th: ตำแหน่งลูกระบุโดยผู้ใช้ การบันทึกช็อตใช้ตำแหน่ง GPS ล่าสุดเสมอ
Ball position: user-entered. Shot record.vi: Vị trí bóng nhập thủ công. Cú đánh luôn được ghi bằng vị trí GPS mới.

Check the score. Putts and penalties can.ko: 점수를 확인하세요. 퍼트와 벌타의 합은 전체 타수를 넘을 수 없습니다.
Check the score. Putts and penalties can.ja: スコアを確認してください。パットとペナルティの合計は総打数を超えられません。
Check the score. Putts and penalties can.zh-Hans: 请检查分数。推杆与罚杆之和不能超过总杆数。
Check the score. Putts and penalties can.zh-Hant: 請檢查分數。推桿與罰桿之和不能超過總桿數。
Check the score. Putts and penalties can.es: Revisa el resultado. Putts y penalizaciones no pueden superar los golpes totales.
Check the score. Putts and penalties can.pt-BR: Confira a pontuação. Putts e penalidades não podem superar o total de tacadas.
Check the score. Putts and penalties can.de: Score prüfen. Putts plus Strafschläge dürfen die Gesamtschläge nicht übersteigen.
Check the score. Putts and penalties can.fr: Vérifiez le score. Putts et pénalités ne peuvent dépasser le total des coups.
Check the score. Putts and penalties can.it: Controlla il punteggio. Putt e penalità non possono superare i colpi totali.
Check the score. Putts and penalties can.th: ตรวจสอบสกอร์ ผลรวมพัตต์และโทษปรับต้องไม่เกินสโตรกรวม
Check the score. Putts and penalties can.vi: Kiểm tra điểm. Tổng putt và gậy phạt không được vượt tổng số gậy.

Complete or delete the pending shot befo.ko: 라운드를 끝내기 전에 대기 중인 샷을 완료하거나 삭제하세요.
Complete or delete the pending shot befo.ja: ラウンドを終了する前に、未完了のショットを完了または削除してください。
Complete or delete the pending shot befo.zh-Hans: 结束球局前，请完成或删除待记录的击球。
Complete or delete the pending shot befo.zh-Hant: 結束球局前，請完成或刪除待記錄的擊球。
Complete or delete the pending shot befo.es: Completa o elimina el golpe pendiente antes de finalizar la vuelta.
Complete or delete the pending shot befo.pt-BR: Conclua ou exclua a tacada pendente antes de encerrar a rodada.
Complete or delete the pending shot befo.de: Ausstehenden Schlag vor Rundenende abschließen oder löschen.
Complete or delete the pending shot befo.fr: Terminez ou supprimez le coup en attente avant de terminer la partie.
Complete or delete the pending shot befo.it: Completa o elimina il colpo in sospeso prima di terminare il giro.
Complete or delete the pending shot befo.th: ทำช็อตที่ค้างให้เสร็จหรือลบก่อนจบรอบ
Complete or delete the pending shot befo.vi: Hoàn tất hoặc xóa cú đánh đang chờ trước khi kết thúc vòng đấu.

Course search is unavailable. Try again.ko: 코스를 검색할 수 없습니다. 인터넷에 연결한 후 다시 시도하세요.
Course search is unavailable. Try again.ja: コースを検索できません。インターネットに接続して再試行してください。
Course search is unavailable. Try again.zh-Hans: 无法搜索球场。连接网络后重试。
Course search is unavailable. Try again.zh-Hant: 無法搜尋球場。連線網路後再試。
Course search is unavailable. Try again.es: No se puede buscar. Conéctate a internet e inténtalo de nuevo.
Course search is unavailable. Try again.pt-BR: Busca indisponível. Conecte-se à internet e tente novamente.
Course search is unavailable. Try again.de: Platzsuche nicht verfügbar. Mit Internetverbindung erneut versuchen.
Course search is unavailable. Try again.fr: Recherche indisponible. Réessayez avec une connexion internet.
Course search is unavailable. Try again.it: Ricerca non disponibile. Riprova con una connessione internet.
Course search is unavailable. Try again.th: ค้นหาสนามไม่ได้ เชื่อมต่ออินเทอร์เน็ตแล้วลองอีกครั้ง
Course search is unavailable. Try again.vi: Không thể tìm sân. Hãy kết nối internet rồi thử lại.

GPS is stale or too uncertain for shot r.ko: GPS가 오래되었거나 정확도가 낮아 샷을 기록할 수 없습니다. GPS를 새로고침하세요.
GPS is stale or too uncertain for shot r.ja: GPSが古いか精度不足のため記録できません。GPSを更新してください。
GPS is stale or too uncertain for shot r.zh-Hans: GPS定位过旧或精度不足，无法记录击球。请刷新GPS。
GPS is stale or too uncertain for shot r.zh-Hant: GPS定位過舊或精度不足，無法記錄擊球。請更新GPS。
GPS is stale or too uncertain for shot r.es: GPS antiguo o impreciso para registrar golpes. Actualiza el GPS.
GPS is stale or too uncertain for shot r.pt-BR: GPS antigo ou impreciso para registrar tacadas. Atualize o GPS.
GPS is stale or too uncertain for shot r.de: GPS zu alt oder ungenau für Schlagaufzeichnung. GPS aktualisieren.
GPS is stale or too uncertain for shot r.fr: GPS trop ancien ou imprécis pour enregistrer un coup. Actualisez-le.
GPS is stale or too uncertain for shot r.it: GPS datato o impreciso per registrare il colpo. Aggiorna il GPS.
GPS is stale or too uncertain for shot r.th: GPS เก่าหรือคลาดเคลื่อนเกินไปสำหรับบันทึกช็อต โปรดอัปเดต GPS
GPS is stale or too uncertain for shot r.vi: GPS đã cũ hoặc quá thiếu chính xác để ghi cú đánh. Hãy làm mới GPS.

GPS records the distance between two pos.ko: GPS는 두 위치 사이의 거리를 기록합니다. 구름 거리와 GPS 오차가 포함되며, 공중 비행 거리 측정값이 아닙니다.
GPS records the distance between two pos.ja: GPSは2地点間の距離を記録します。ランとGPS誤差を含み、実測キャリーではありません。
GPS records the distance between two pos.zh-Hans: GPS记录两点间的距离，包含滚动和GPS误差，不是实测空中距离。
GPS records the distance between two pos.zh-Hant: GPS記錄兩點間的距離，包含滾動和GPS誤差，不是實測空中距離。
GPS records the distance between two pos.es: GPS registra la distancia entre posiciones, incluido el rodamiento y su incertidumbre. No mide el vuelo.
GPS records the distance between two pos.pt-BR: GPS registra a distância entre posições, incluindo rolagem e incerteza. Não mede carry aéreo.
GPS records the distance between two pos.de: GPS erfasst die Entfernung zwischen Positionen, einschließlich Roll und GPS-Unsicherheit. Kein gemessener Carry.
GPS records the distance between two pos.fr: Le GPS mesure la distance entre deux positions, roulement et incertitude compris. Ce n’est pas une portée aérienne mesurée.
GPS records the distance between two pos.it: Il GPS registra la distanza tra posizioni, inclusi rotolamento e incertezza. Non misura il carry in volo.
GPS records the distance between two pos.th: GPS บันทึกระยะระหว่างสองตำแหน่ง รวมการกลิ้งและความคลาดเคลื่อน ไม่ใช่การวัดระยะลอยตัว
GPS records the distance between two pos.vi: GPS ghi khoảng cách giữa hai vị trí, gồm lăn bóng và sai số GPS; đây không phải carry trên không đo được.

GPS shots measure ground displacement, i.ko: GPS 샷은 구름 거리를 포함한 지표 이동 거리를 기록합니다. 캐리 통계는 변경하지 않습니다.
GPS shots measure ground displacement, i.ja: GPSショットはランを含む地表変位です。キャリー統計は更新しません。
GPS shots measure ground displacement, i.zh-Hans: GPS击球记录含滚动的地面位移，不会更新空中距离统计。
GPS shots measure ground displacement, i.zh-Hant: GPS擊球記錄含滾動的地面位移，不會更新空中距離統計。
GPS shots measure ground displacement, i.es: Los golpes GPS miden desplazamiento con rodamiento. No actualizan estadísticas de vuelo.
GPS shots measure ground displacement, i.pt-BR: Tacadas GPS medem deslocamento com rolagem. Não atualizam estatísticas de carry.
GPS shots measure ground displacement, i.de: GPS-Schläge erfassen Bodenentfernung mit Roll. Carry-Statistiken bleiben unverändert.
GPS shots measure ground displacement, i.fr: Les coups GPS mesurent le déplacement au sol avec roulement, sans modifier les statistiques de portée.
GPS shots measure ground displacement, i.it: I colpi GPS misurano lo spostamento con rotolamento. Non aggiornano le statistiche di carry.
GPS shots measure ground displacement, i.th: ช็อต GPS วัดระยะเคลื่อนที่รวมการกลิ้ง โดยไม่อัปเดตสถิติแคร์รี่
GPS shots measure ground displacement, i.vi: Cú đánh GPS đo dịch chuyển trên đất, gồm lăn bóng. Không cập nhật thống kê carry.

Hazard probabilities and safer aim point.ko: 해저드 확률과 더 안전한 조준점에는 검증된 코스 지형이 필요하며 현재 제공되지 않습니다.
Hazard probabilities and safer aim point.ja: ハザード確率と安全な狙い所には検証済みコース形状が必要なため、利用できません。
Hazard probabilities and safer aim point.zh-Hans: 障碍概率和更安全的瞄准点需要经验证的球场几何数据，目前不可用。
Hazard probabilities and safer aim point.zh-Hant: 障礙機率和更安全的瞄準點需要經驗證的球場幾何資料，目前無法提供。
Hazard probabilities and safer aim point.es: Las probabilidades de obstáculos y objetivos más seguros requieren geometría verificada; no están disponibles.
Hazard probabilities and safer aim point.pt-BR: Probabilidades de obstáculos e alvos mais seguros exigem geometria validada e estão indisponíveis.
Hazard probabilities and safer aim point.de: Hinderniswahrscheinlichkeiten und sicherere Ziele benötigen geprüfte Platzgeometrie und sind nicht verfügbar.
Hazard probabilities and safer aim point.fr: Probabilités d’obstacles et cibles plus sûres nécessitent une géométrie vérifiée et sont indisponibles.
Hazard probabilities and safer aim point.it: Probabilità di ostacoli e mire più sicure richiedono geometrie verificate e non sono disponibili.
Hazard probabilities and safer aim point.th: ความน่าจะเป็นของอุปสรรคและจุดเล็งที่ปลอดภัยกว่าต้องใช้รูปทรงสนามที่ตรวจสอบแล้ว จึงยังไม่มีข้อมูล
Hazard probabilities and safer aim point.vi: Xác suất chướng ngại và điểm ngắm an toàn hơn cần hình học sân đã xác minh nên hiện chưa có.

Leave unrecorded values empty. Total str.ko: 기록하지 않은 값은 비워 두세요. 전체 타수에는 퍼트와 벌타가 포함됩니다.
Leave unrecorded values empty. Total str.ja: 未記録の値は空欄にしてください。総打数にはパットとペナルティを含みます。
Leave unrecorded values empty. Total str.zh-Hans: 未记录的值请留空。总杆数包含推杆和罚杆。
Leave unrecorded values empty. Total str.zh-Hant: 未記錄的值請留空。總桿數包含推桿和罰桿。
Leave unrecorded values empty. Total str.es: Deja vacíos los datos no registrados. El total incluye putts y penalizaciones.
Leave unrecorded values empty. Total str.pt-BR: Deixe vazios os valores não registrados. O total inclui putts e penalidades.
Leave unrecorded values empty. Total str.de: Nicht erfasste Werte leer lassen. Gesamtschläge enthalten Putts und Strafschläge.
Leave unrecorded values empty. Total str.fr: Laissez les valeurs non saisies vides. Le total inclut putts et pénalités.
Leave unrecorded values empty. Total str.it: Lascia vuoti i valori non registrati. Il totale include putt e penalità.
Leave unrecorded values empty. Total str.th: เว้นค่าที่ยังไม่บันทึกไว้ สโตรกรวมรวมพัตต์และโทษปรับแล้ว
Leave unrecorded values empty. Total str.vi: Để trống giá trị chưa ghi. Tổng số gậy gồm putt và gậy phạt.

Location access is off. Enable it in iPh.ko: 위치 접근이 꺼져 있습니다. GPS 샷을 기록하려면 iPhone 설정에서 허용하세요.
Location access is off. Enable it in iPh.ja: 位置情報へのアクセスが無効です。GPSショットの記録にはiPhoneの設定で許可してください。
Location access is off. Enable it in iPh.zh-Hans: 位置权限已关闭。请在iPhone设置中开启，以记录GPS击球。
Location access is off. Enable it in iPh.zh-Hant: 位置權限已關閉。請在iPhone設定中開啟，以記錄GPS擊球。
Location access is off. Enable it in iPh.es: Ubicación desactivada. Actívala en Ajustes del iPhone para registrar golpes GPS.
Location access is off. Enable it in iPh.pt-BR: Localização desativada. Ative nos Ajustes do iPhone para registrar tacadas GPS.
Location access is off. Enable it in iPh.de: Standortzugriff aus. Zum Erfassen von GPS-Schlägen in den iPhone-Einstellungen aktivieren.
Location access is off. Enable it in iPh.fr: Accès à la localisation désactivé. Activez-le dans Réglages pour enregistrer les coups GPS.
Location access is off. Enable it in iPh.it: Accesso alla posizione disattivato. Attivalo nelle Impostazioni per registrare colpi GPS.
Location access is off. Enable it in iPh.th: การเข้าถึงตำแหน่งปิดอยู่ เปิดในตั้งค่า iPhone เพื่อบันทึกช็อต GPS
Location access is off. Enable it in iPh.vi: Quyền vị trí đang tắt. Bật trong Cài đặt iPhone để ghi cú đánh GPS.

Location services are unavailable. You c.ko: 위치 서비스를 사용할 수 없습니다. 지도에서 목표는 선택할 수 있습니다.
Location services are unavailable. You c.ja: 位置情報サービスを利用できません。地図上の目標は選択できます。
Location services are unavailable. You c.zh-Hans: 定位服务不可用。仍可在地图上选择目标。
Location services are unavailable. You c.zh-Hant: 定位服務無法使用。仍可在地圖上選擇目標。
Location services are unavailable. You c.es: Ubicación no disponible. Aún puedes elegir objetivos en el mapa.
Location services are unavailable. You c.pt-BR: Localização indisponível. Você ainda pode escolher alvos no mapa.
Location services are unavailable. You c.de: Standortdienste nicht verfügbar. Ziele können auf der Karte gewählt werden.
Location services are unavailable. You c.fr: Localisation indisponible. Vous pouvez toujours choisir des cibles sur la carte.

No places found. Try the course name wit.ja: 場所が見つかりません。コース名に都市名を加えてください。
No places found. Try the course name wit.zh-Hans: 未找到地点。请同时输入球场名和城市。
No places found. Try the course name wit.zh-Hant: 找不到地點。請同時輸入球場名和城市。

No places found. Try the course name wit.it: Nessun luogo trovato. Prova nome del percorso e città.
No places found. Try the course name wit.th: ไม่พบสถานที่ ลองระบุชื่อสนามพร้อมเมือง

No usable GPS fix. Move to an open area.ja: 使用可能なGPS位置がありません。開けた場所で再試行してください。
No usable GPS fix. Move to an open area.zh-Hans: 无可用GPS定位。请移至开阔区域重试。
No usable GPS fix. Move to an open area.zh-Hant: 無可用GPS定位。請移至開闊區域再試。
No usable GPS fix. Move to an open area.es: Sin posición GPS válida. Ve a un lugar abierto e inténtalo de nuevo.
No usable GPS fix. Move to an open area.pt-BR: Sem posição GPS válida. Vá para uma área aberta e tente novamente.
No usable GPS fix. Move to an open area.de: Keine nutzbare GPS-Position. Im Freien erneut versuchen.
No usable GPS fix. Move to an open area.fr: Aucune position GPS utilisable. Réessayez dans un espace dégagé.
No usable GPS fix. Move to an open area.it: Nessuna posizione GPS valida. Riprova in un’area aperta.
No usable GPS fix. Move to an open area.th: ไม่มีตำแหน่ง GPS ที่ใช้ได้ ไปยังพื้นที่โล่งแล้วลองอีกครั้ง
No usable GPS fix. Move to an open area.vi: Không có vị trí GPS dùng được. Di chuyển tới nơi thoáng rồi thử lại.

Clubs are ranked by squared distance fro.ko: 목표와의 거리 제곱에 캐리·좌우 분산을 더해 클럽을 비교합니다. 안전 전략은 분산을 더 크게, 공격 전략은 더 작게 반영합니다.
Clubs are ranked by squared distance fro.ja: 目標からの距離の二乗と前後・左右の分散で比較します。安全重視は分散の重みを大きく、攻め重視は小さくします。
Clubs are ranked by squared distance fro.zh-Hans: 按距目标距离的平方加上前后及左右方差排列球杆。保守策略提高方差权重，积极策略降低权重。
Clubs are ranked by squared distance fro.zh-Hant: 按距目標距離的平方加上前後及左右變異數排列球桿。保守策略提高變異數權重，積極策略降低權重。
Clubs are ranked by squared distance fro.es: Se ordenan por distancia al objetivo al cuadrado más variabilidad longitudinal y lateral. La estrategia conservadora pondera más la variabilidad; la agresiva, menos.
Clubs are ranked by squared distance fro.pt-BR: A classificação soma a distância ao alvo ao quadrado e a variabilidade de carry e lateral. A estratégia conservadora dá mais peso à variabilidade; a agressiva, menos.
Clubs are ranked by squared distance fro.de: Rangfolge nach quadrierter Zielentfernung plus Carry- und Seitenvarianz. Konservativ gewichtet Varianz stärker, aggressiv schwächer.
Clubs are ranked by squared distance fro.fr: Classement selon le carré de la distance à la cible et les variances en portée et latérale. Le mode prudent pondère davantage la variance, le mode agressif moins.
Clubs are ranked by squared distance fro.it: Classifica basata sulla distanza al quadrato dall’obiettivo più varianza di carry e laterale. Prudente dà più peso alla varianza, aggressiva meno.
Clubs are ranked by squared distance fro.th: จัดอันดับจากระยะห่างเป้าหมายยกกำลังสองบวกความแปรปรวนแคร์รี่และด้านข้าง แบบระมัดระวังให้น้ำหนักความแปรปรวนมากกว่า แบบเชิงรุกให้น้อยกว่า
Clubs are ranked by squared distance fro.vi: Xếp hạng theo bình phương khoảng cách đến mục tiêu cộng phương sai carry và ngang. Thận trọng coi trọng phương sai hơn; tấn công coi trọng ít hơn.

Pars start empty unless you entered them.ko: 이전에 입력하지 않은 파는 비어 있습니다. 스코어카드에서 타수·퍼트·벌타를 입력하세요.
Pars start empty unless you entered them.ja: パーは以前入力したもの以外は空欄です。スコアカードで打数・パット・ペナルティを入力してください。
Pars start empty unless you entered them.zh-Hans: 标准杆默认为空，除非曾手动输入。请在记分卡中填写杆数、推杆和罚杆。
Pars start empty unless you entered them.zh-Hant: 標準桿預設為空，除非曾手動輸入。請在計分卡中填寫桿數、推桿和罰桿。
Pars start empty unless you entered them.es: El par queda vacío si no se introdujo antes. Añade golpes, putts y penalizaciones en la tarjeta.
Pars start empty unless you entered them.pt-BR: O par fica vazio se não foi informado antes. Adicione tacadas, putts e penalidades no cartão.
Pars start empty unless you entered them.de: Par bleibt ohne frühere Eingabe leer. Schläge, Putts und Strafschläge in der Scorekarte eintragen.
Pars start empty unless you entered them.fr: Les pars restent vides s’ils n’ont pas été saisis. Ajoutez coups, putts et pénalités sur la carte.
Pars start empty unless you entered them.it: Il par resta vuoto se non già inserito. Aggiungi colpi, putt e penalità nel segnapunti.
Pars start empty unless you entered them.th: พาร์จะว่างหากยังไม่เคยกรอก เพิ่มสโตรก พัตต์ และโทษปรับในสกอร์การ์ด
Pars start empty unless you entered them.vi: Par để trống nếu chưa từng nhập. Thêm số gậy, putt và gậy phạt trong bảng điểm.

Refresh GPS at the next ball position be.ko: 샷을 완료하기 전에 다음 공 위치에서 GPS를 새로고침하세요.
Refresh GPS at the next ball position be.ja: ショットを完了する前に、次のボール位置でGPSを更新してください。
Refresh GPS at the next ball position be.zh-Hans: 完成击球前，请在下一个球位刷新GPS。
Refresh GPS at the next ball position be.zh-Hant: 完成擊球前，請在下一個球位更新GPS。
Refresh GPS at the next ball position be.es: Actualiza el GPS en la siguiente posición de la bola antes de finalizar el golpe.
Refresh GPS at the next ball position be.pt-BR: Atualize o GPS na próxima posição da bola antes de concluir a tacada.
Refresh GPS at the next ball position be.de: Vor Abschluss GPS an der nächsten Ballposition aktualisieren.
Refresh GPS at the next ball position be.fr: Actualisez le GPS à la prochaine position de balle avant de terminer le coup.
Refresh GPS at the next ball position be.it: Aggiorna il GPS alla prossima posizione della palla prima di completare il colpo.
Refresh GPS at the next ball position be.th: อัปเดต GPS ที่ตำแหน่งลูกถัดไปก่อนจบช็อต
Refresh GPS at the next ball position be.vi: Làm mới GPS tại vị trí bóng tiếp theo trước khi hoàn tất cú đánh.

Refresh GPS first. Shot recording needs.ko: 먼저 GPS를 새로고침하세요. 샷 기록에는 20초 이내, 정확도 30미터 이내인 위치가 필요합니다.
Refresh GPS first. Shot recording needs.ja: まずGPSを更新してください。記録には20秒以内で精度30メートル以内の位置が必要です。
Refresh GPS first. Shot recording needs.zh-Hans: 请先刷新GPS。击球记录需要20秒内、精度在30米内的定位。
Refresh GPS first. Shot recording needs.zh-Hant: 請先更新GPS。擊球記錄需要20秒內、精度在30公尺內的定位。
Refresh GPS first. Shot recording needs.es: Actualiza el GPS. Se necesita una posición de menos de 20 segundos y precisión de 30 metros o mejor.
Refresh GPS first. Shot recording needs.pt-BR: Atualize o GPS. É necessária uma posição com menos de 20 segundos e precisão de até 30 metros.
Refresh GPS first. Shot recording needs.de: GPS aktualisieren. Erforderlich: Position höchstens 20 Sekunden alt und Genauigkeit innerhalb 30 Metern.
Refresh GPS first. Shot recording needs.fr: Actualisez le GPS. Position requise : moins de 20 secondes et précision de 30 mètres maximum.
Refresh GPS first. Shot recording needs.it: Aggiorna il GPS. Servono una posizione entro 20 secondi e precisione entro 30 metri.
Refresh GPS first. Shot recording needs.th: อัปเดต GPS ก่อน ต้องใช้ตำแหน่งอายุไม่เกิน 20 วินาทีและคลาดเคลื่อนไม่เกิน 30 เมตร
Refresh GPS first. Shot recording needs.vi: Làm mới GPS trước. Cần vị trí trong 20 giây với độ chính xác trong 30 mét.

Search uses Apple Maps and needs interne.ko: 검색은 Apple 지도를 사용하며 인터넷이 필요합니다. 결과는 장소 정보이며 검증된 홀 배치가 아닙니다.
Search uses Apple Maps and needs interne.ja: 検索はAppleマップを使用し、インターネットが必要です。結果は施設情報で、検証済みのホール形状ではありません。
Search uses Apple Maps and needs interne.zh-Hans: 搜索使用Apple地图并需要联网。结果为地点信息，不是经验证的球洞布局。
Search uses Apple Maps and needs interne.zh-Hant: 搜尋使用Apple地圖並需要連網。結果為地點資訊，不是經驗證的球洞配置。
Search uses Apple Maps and needs interne.es: La búsqueda usa Mapas de Apple y necesita internet. Los resultados son lugares, no planos de hoyos verificados.
Search uses Apple Maps and needs interne.pt-BR: A busca usa Mapas da Apple e requer internet. Os resultados são locais, não layouts de buracos validados.
Search uses Apple Maps and needs interne.de: Suche über Apple Karten mit Internet. Ergebnisse sind Orte, keine geprüften Lochpläne.
Search uses Apple Maps and needs interne.fr: La recherche utilise Plans d’Apple avec internet. Les résultats sont des lieux, pas des tracés de trous vérifiés.
Search uses Apple Maps and needs interne.it: La ricerca usa Mappe di Apple e richiede internet. I risultati sono luoghi, non tracciati di buche verificati.
Search uses Apple Maps and needs interne.th: การค้นหาใช้ Apple Maps และต้องมีอินเทอร์เน็ต ผลลัพธ์เป็นสถานที่ ไม่ใช่ผังหลุมที่ตรวจสอบแล้ว
Search uses Apple Maps and needs interne.vi: Tìm kiếm dùng Apple Maps và cần internet. Kết quả là địa điểm, không phải sơ đồ hố đã xác minh.

Start a round from Course to keep a scor.ko: 코스에서 라운드를 시작해 스코어카드와 GPS 샷을 기록하세요.
Start a round from Course to keep a scor.ja: コースからラウンドを開始して、スコアカードとGPSショットを記録しましょう。
Start a round from Course to keep a scor.zh-Hans: 在球场页面开始球局，即可填写记分卡并记录GPS击球。
Start a round from Course to keep a scor.zh-Hant: 在球場頁面開始球局，即可填寫計分卡並記錄GPS擊球。
Start a round from Course to keep a scor.es: Inicia una vuelta desde Campo para llevar la tarjeta y registrar golpes GPS.
Start a round from Course to keep a scor.pt-BR: Inicie uma rodada em Campo para manter o cartão e registrar tacadas GPS.
Start a round from Course to keep a scor.de: Unter Golfplatz eine Runde starten, um Scorekarte und GPS-Schläge zu erfassen.
Start a round from Course to keep a scor.fr: Démarrez une partie dans Parcours pour tenir la carte et enregistrer les coups GPS.
Start a round from Course to keep a scor.it: Inizia un giro da Percorso per tenere il segnapunti e registrare colpi GPS.
Start a round from Course to keep a scor.th: เริ่มรอบจากสนามเพื่อใช้สกอร์การ์ดและบันทึกช็อต GPS
Start a round from Course to keep a scor.vi: Bắt đầu vòng đấu ở Sân golf để ghi bảng điểm và cú đánh GPS.

Strokes include putts and penalties. GPS.ko: 타수에는 퍼트와 벌타가 포함됩니다. GPS 샷 기록은 점수를 자동 변경하지 않습니다.
Strokes include putts and penalties. GPS.ja: 打数にはパットとペナルティを含みます。GPSショット履歴でスコアは自動変更されません。
Strokes include putts and penalties. GPS.zh-Hans: 杆数包含推杆和罚杆。GPS击球记录不会自动更改分数。
Strokes include putts and penalties. GPS.zh-Hant: 桿數包含推桿和罰桿。GPS擊球記錄不會自動更改分數。
Strokes include putts and penalties. GPS.es: Los golpes incluyen putts y penalizaciones. El registro GPS no cambia el resultado automáticamente.
Strokes include putts and penalties. GPS.pt-BR: As tacadas incluem putts e penalidades. O registro GPS não altera o placar automaticamente.
Strokes include putts and penalties. GPS.de: Schläge enthalten Putts und Strafschläge. GPS-Aufzeichnungen ändern den Score nicht automatisch.
Strokes include putts and penalties. GPS.fr: Les coups incluent putts et pénalités. Le journal GPS ne modifie pas automatiquement le score.
Strokes include putts and penalties. GPS.it: I colpi includono putt e penalità. Il registro GPS non cambia il punteggio automaticamente.
Strokes include putts and penalties. GPS.th: สโตรกรวมพัตต์และโทษปรับแล้ว บันทึก GPS ไม่เปลี่ยนสกอร์อัตโนมัติ
Strokes include putts and penalties. GPS.vi: Số gậy gồm putt và gậy phạt. Nhật ký GPS không tự thay đổi điểm.

Tap the location button for GPS, or plac.ko: 위치 버튼으로 GPS를 요청하거나 지도에 공 위치를 표시하세요.
Tap the location button for GPS, or plac.ja: 位置ボタンでGPSを取得するか、地図上にボール位置を配置してください。
Tap the location button for GPS, or plac.zh-Hans: 点击定位按钮获取GPS，或在地图上设置球位。
Tap the location button for GPS, or plac.zh-Hant: 點選定位按鈕取得GPS，或在地圖上設定球位。
Tap the location button for GPS, or plac.es: Pulsa ubicación para obtener GPS o coloca la bola en el mapa.
Tap the location button for GPS, or plac.pt-BR: Toque em localização para usar GPS ou marque a bola no mapa.
Tap the location button for GPS, or plac.de: Standorttaste für GPS antippen oder Ballposition auf Karte setzen.
Tap the location button for GPS, or plac.fr: Touchez la localisation pour le GPS ou placez la balle sur la carte.
Tap the location button for GPS, or plac.it: Tocca la posizione per il GPS o posiziona la palla sulla mappa.
Tap the location button for GPS, or plac.th: แตะปุ่มตำแหน่งเพื่อใช้ GPS หรือวางตำแหน่งลูกบนแผนที่
Tap the location button for GPS, or plac.vi: Chạm nút vị trí để dùng GPS hoặc đặt vị trí bóng trên bản đồ.

Tap the map to place the selected refere.ko: 지도를 탭하여 선택한 참고 지점을 표시하세요. 목표 깃발을 드래그해 조준점을 조정하세요.
Tap the map to place the selected refere.ja: 地図をタップして参考点を配置します。目標の旗をドラッグして狙いを調整できます。
Tap the map to place the selected refere.zh-Hans: 点击地图放置所选参考点。拖动目标旗调整瞄准点。
Tap the map to place the selected refere.zh-Hant: 點選地圖放置所選參考點。拖曳目標旗調整瞄準點。
Tap the map to place the selected refere.es: Toca el mapa para colocar la referencia. Arrastra la bandera para ajustar el objetivo.
Tap the map to place the selected refere.pt-BR: Toque no mapa para marcar a referência. Arraste a bandeira para ajustar a mira.
Tap the map to place the selected refere.de: Karte antippen, um Referenz zu setzen. Zielfahne ziehen, um die Richtung anzupassen.
Tap the map to place the selected refere.fr: Touchez la carte pour placer le repère. Faites glisser le drapeau pour ajuster la visée.
Tap the map to place the selected refere.it: Tocca la mappa per inserire il riferimento. Trascina la bandiera per regolare la mira.
Tap the map to place the selected refere.th: แตะแผนที่เพื่อวางจุดอ้างอิงที่เลือก ลากธงเป้าหมายเพื่อปรับแนวเล็ง
Tap the map to place the selected refere.vi: Chạm bản đồ để đặt điểm tham chiếu. Kéo cờ mục tiêu để chỉnh hướng ngắm.

This displacement is small relative to t.ko: 이 거리는 GPS의 보고된 오차에 비해 작습니다.
This displacement is small relative to t.ja: この変位は報告されたGPS誤差に比べて小さい値です。
This displacement is small relative to t.zh-Hans: 相对于GPS报告的误差，此位移较小。
This displacement is small relative to t.zh-Hant: 相對於GPS回報的誤差，此位移較小。
This displacement is small relative to t.es: El desplazamiento es pequeño respecto a la incertidumbre GPS indicada.
This displacement is small relative to t.pt-BR: O deslocamento é pequeno em relação à incerteza GPS informada.
This displacement is small relative to t.de: Die Entfernung ist klein im Verhältnis zur gemeldeten GPS-Unsicherheit.
This displacement is small relative to t.fr: Ce déplacement est faible par rapport à l’incertitude GPS signalée.
This displacement is small relative to t.it: Lo spostamento è piccolo rispetto all’incertezza GPS indicata.
This displacement is small relative to t.th: ระยะเคลื่อนที่นี้น้อยเมื่อเทียบกับความคลาดเคลื่อน GPS ที่รายงาน
This displacement is small relative to t.vi: Độ dịch chuyển này nhỏ so với sai số GPS được báo.

This is a statistical estimate from your.ko: 직접 입력한 클럽 정보에 따른 통계 추정입니다. 바람·고도·라이·구름 거리·해저드 형상은 반영되지 않습니다. 샷을 선택하기 전에 착지 구역을 확인하세요.
This is a statistical estimate from your.ja: 入力したクラブ情報に基づく統計推定です。風・標高・ライ・ラン・ハザード形状は未反映です。ショットを選ぶ前に着地エリアを確認してください。
This is a statistical estimate from your.zh-Hans: 这是基于已输入球杆资料的统计估计。风、海拔、球位、滚动和障碍几何信息不可用。选杆前请确认落地区域。
This is a statistical estimate from your.zh-Hant: 這是基於已輸入球桿資料的統計估計。風、海拔、球位、滾動和障礙幾何資訊無法提供。選桿前請確認落地區域。
This is a statistical estimate from your.es: Estimación estadística de tu perfil de palos. No incluye viento, elevación, lie, rodamiento ni geometría de obstáculos. Comprueba la zona de caída antes de elegir.
